name: Vanquish the Invaders!
label: Quest
description: Vanquish the Invaders!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young adventurer. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.
Enter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. Push back the invading Horde forces!
Do this, and earn a Mark of Honor. Bring it to me, friend, and I shall reward you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you fought in Warsong Gulch and defended Silverwing Hold?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. Continue to aid the cause and bring me more Marks of Honor. Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.
